title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics expand in GCC and GCC High
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, cloud qualifications, licensing attribution and documented controls are supported. It should report the Copilot Dashboard page's lower licensing threshold alongside the conflicting environment requirements page, and complete the two policy-creation paths.
